theme: planning obligations community infrastructure levy viability and contribution reporting

sources.title: Planning obligations
sources.facts: Explains statutory and policy tests for section 106 obligations, relationship with conditions and CIL, viability and reporting.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove a specific obligation is necessary, executed, enforceable, paid or discharged.

sources.title: Community Infrastructure Levy
sources.facts: Updated 17 June 2026; covers charging, relief, liability, collection, spending, appeals and infrastructure funding statements.
sources.guard: National CIL guidance does not establish local charging status, exact liability, relief, payment or spending.

sources.title: Viability
sources.facts: Sets expectations for proportionate evidence, standardised inputs, public availability and developer-contribution monitoring.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove a scheme is viable or justify a site-specific contribution reduction.

sources.title: Publish your developer contributions data
sources.facts: Defines CSV structure for agreements, contributions and transactions supporting infrastructure funding statements.
sources.guard: A publication standard does not prove local data is complete, current, reconciled or legally determinative.

sources.title: Planning obligations: good practice advice
sources.facts: Addresses drafting, justification, affordable housing, modification and discharge of obligations.
sources.guard: Good-practice advice does not create, modify or discharge an individual deed.

sources.title: Plan-making
sources.facts: Updated 27 November 2025; links infrastructure requirements, funding evidence, strategic cooperation and plan viability.
sources.guard: Plan evidence does not prove infrastructure funding is secured or delivery will occur.

sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework - Decision-making
sources.facts: Requires viability assessments to reflect national guidance and be publicly available, with weight determined by decision makers.
sources.guard: National policy does not determine the weight or outcome of a specific assessment or application.

sources.title: Appeal a modification or discharge of planning obligation application (S106)
sources.facts: Explains the appeal route following decisions or non-determination of modification/discharge applications.
sources.guard: Appeal guidance does not prove an appeal exists, succeeds or changes an obligation.

package_guard: Planning-obligation, CIL, viability, data-publication, plan-making and appeal guidance do not by themselves prove exact-site liability, executed deeds, affordable-housing terms, payment, relief, allocation, expenditure, infrastructure funding, delivery, viability, modification, discharge or planning approval.
